messages.content: Include quotes within quotes within quotes, at least 3 levels deep, alternating between double quotes and single quotes. On a vertical surface the temperature excess over the ambient temperature, which is taken as constant, varies as (1/x), where x is the distance along the surface from the leading edge. Obtain the variation with x of the following physical variables in the natural convection flow; q", Q, delta(boundary layer thickness), u_max" and v(infinite). Is this circumstance obtainable physically? If so, under what conditions would this flow arise?
